user.title: Connect to Amway Atmosphere
user.description:
Please choose one of the following methods to connect your Atmosphere purifier:

⭐ **Method 1: Official OAuth Authorization (Recommended, Auto-refreshes forever)**
1. Open the official login portal in your browser:
[👉 Click here to sign in on Amway Official Portal]({auth_url})
2. After sign in, the browser will attempt to redirect to `amwayhealthyhome://loginRedirect?code=...`.
3. Copy the full redirect URL (or just the `code`) and paste it into the 'Authorization Code or URL' field below.

💡 **Method 2: Token Assistant Tool**
Run `python3 tools/get_token.py` in this repo to capture token or JSON string, then paste into 'Access Token or JSON' below.

📱 **Method 3: Phone Number & Password**
Enter your registered phone number and password (if restricted by Amway cloud, please use Method 1).
